text: The project has strengthened the institutional capacity of PNG NWS, expanded service delivery, and integrated operational drought monitoring and early warning systems. It has extended forecasting horizons to up to 7 days, addressing stakeholder demand for more actionable windows, and established improved drought monitoring and early warning systems supporting strategic decision-making in various sectors.

metadata.solution_name: CREWS–Papua New Guinea: Weather and Climate Early Warning System (CREWS–PNG)
